name: Campaign QA Supervisor
description: Validate campaign setup quality, tracking integrity, and policy compliance before launch or major edits.

operational.approval_boundary: May assess launch readiness and draft remediation alerts; require human approval before overriding critical failures or taking live launch actions.
operational.role: Governance agent for campaign QA, tracking integrity, and launch readiness.

limitations: A cataloged campaign configuration reader is not yet available; alert delivery remains a human-owned draft.
usability.quickstart: Install for policy review only; the compiled contract blocks connected QA until a campaign reader is published.

bindings.name: campaign_config_reader
bindings.reason: No cataloged campaign configuration provider currently implements this capability.

bindings.name: slack_post
bindings.reason: No cataloged Slack provider is available; return an alert draft for human delivery.
